captions_meta.li_hook:
Plenty of marketing teams still distribute releases with a contact spreadsheet, one-by-one emails and screenshots as a report.
There's a tidier way.
li_body: VRITIMES is built for start-ups and SMEs that want their releases published without building a media database from scratch.
The workflow sits in one dashboard:
li_points: Write and upload your press release.
Distribution with guaranteed media placement per release (the number of outlets depends on the plan).
A backlink to your site and sharing on VRITIMES social channels.
A post-distribution report ready to forward to your manager or client.
captions_meta.li_close: Current plans and pricing are always on our official page.
captions_meta.fb: Press releases without the admin: write, distribute and see the results in one dashboard. Plans here 👇
